t: Act I acting variant, scene II
d: Wide and pleasant countryside watered by the river Bostreno, scattered with flocks and shepherds. Wide but rustic bridge over the river. First pastoral tugures. View of the city of Sidon in a distance. Aminta seated on a rock, singing to the sound of pastoral avenues: Elisa.
Tamiri in pastoral dress and Agenore.
Elisa, quietly cheerful and hasty, then Aminta.
Agenore followed by Royal Guards, and Nobili of Sidon, who carry on golden kisses the royal insignia, and sayings.
Alternative to the verses ranging from "Here is the pastor / But between' contented oblivion and "Yes," but the sky untiler wants me pastor" .
Great, and rich pavilion of Alessandro on one side; ruine insevatichite of ancient buildings on the other. Field of the Greeks far away. Guards of the same in various places. Elisa, then Agenore.

Inside a large and delicious cave, whimsically formed in the lively rock by nature: distinct, and covered largely by the lively green of the various plants, or by the high hangings, or snakes around: and rejoiced by a vein of clear water, which descends obliquely between stones, now hides, now shows itself, and finally loses. The spacious tunnels, which make the site bright, discover the appearance of different amenes, of unequal hills far away: and in a distance less than some military tent: in order to understand be the place in the vicinity of the Greek field. Aminta solo.

Part of the space surrounded by the great portico of the famous temple of Hercules Tyrus. All the vast enclosure is richly adorned (for the coronation of the new king of Sidon) and of golden vessels, and barbarian carpets, and of festoons of vegetables, and of flowers, which around the numerous columns artificially envelop, and all of them interweave them. From the right side, very far ahead, rich and elevated throne with two seats, above which scepter and royal crown. From the same side, but in greater distance, magnificent entrance of the said temple, to which it ascends for ample and superb staircase. Outside from the porch, to the right, view of the lighthouse and port of Sidon garnished of thick ships: to the left, of the Macedonian phalanx arranged in order, at the sight of the throne. Competition for all of Cittadini, and Pastors. Between the amazing harmony of the military instruments and Alessandro preceded by the Capitani Tamili, and Siguito Nobili.
